items.title: But Does It Have Starlink? It’s the New Must-Have, but at $500k a Plane, Somebody’s Got to Pay
items.summary: Airlines are racing to get into Starlink. The installation costs are high, but airlines are betting that the service will attract more customers.

items.title: Canadian Travel to the U.S. Grew for a 5th Month Despite Trade War — Still Down 27% From 2024
items.summary: Many thought rising political tensions would mean fewer trips — the national data says otherwise. But not every state is seeing the same rebound.

items.title: ‘I Don’t Want Cookie Cutter’: Dorchester Collection’s Stand Against the Flattening of Luxury
items.summary: Dorchester has an interesting market opportunity stemming from its iconic properties and a dial service culture. The challenge is to tighten and refine the basics without taking judgment away from the people who make each property worth returning to.

items.title: Skift Global Forum Preview: Accor CEO on Why Data is Essential, but Instinct Matters Most
items.summary: Accor CEO Sébastien Bazin shares what drives his decisions at scale for one of the world's largest hotel groups. He calls data essential, but says it should feed instinct rather than overrule it, a claim worth testing at Skift Global Forum.

items.title: Middle East’s Recovery Stalled Again: Skift Travel Health Index
items.summary: The Middle East’s recovery remains vulnerable. Renewed travel warnings make a rapid rebound less likely, leaving accommodation providers focused on both rebuilding demand and recovering pricing power.

items.title: See the Confirmed Speakers for Skift Creator Summit 2026
items.summary: Creator-led demand moves across every seat in travel and sits fully inside none of them. The confirmed Creator Summit roster puts the operators who each own a piece of that path in one closed room on September 22.

items.title: Where Travel Stands, 25 Years After 9/11
items.summary: Twenty-five years after 9/11, travel has become remarkably easy for people the system is prepared to move. The growing divide is over who gets that treatment.
